main_text.p: Fides spectat 1. Sanctificationem futuram, & cogitur interim confiteri impuritatem præsentem. Hinc Veteris Testamenti occasio. 2. Sanctificationem sive purificationem peccatorum factam in Sanguine Mediatoris. Hinc origo bonorum Novi Testamenti. quibus duobus Testamentis status hujus vitæ Israëlis variatur.
Resp. 1. An nil nisi Fœdus gratiæ Decalogo contineatur, erat quæstio: atque ipsa decem Præcepta sunt spectanda.
2. Locum, ubi Bucerus hoc diceret, Opponens istic non indicavit. Alibi ab eo producitur Buceri sententia, ex Commentario ad Matth. x, 10. quam ipsum hic spectâsse opinor. Sic autem habet:

p.i: Et hic Canon certissimus est intelligendi quæcunque Dominus privatis præcepit: ut quæ externis circumstantiis addicta sunt, relinquamus iis quibus fuere præcepta: nos verò amplectamur quicquid in eis de universali pietatis ratione, fide scil. & dilectione, præcipitur. Sic Circumcisio, &c. Sic de Sabbatho.

page.notes: Printed page number "199" is set in italic at top right. Marginal reference "4" at foot is the signature beneath the last line. Text in the printed Latin is set partly in italics; the word "Sabbatho" is split across lines as "Sabba-" / "tho." Possible printing errors left as printed: "Præceptassunt" rendered as "Præcepta sunt"; "Sabba-tho" hyphenation. The fragment "tho." is a line-end continuation of the word and has been joined.
